Title: Privacy Policy
MetaDescription: How Tedwren collects, uses and protects your personal data.

Sections.Heading: Who we are
Sections.Body: Tedwren Ltd operates this website and the Tedwren service. This policy explains what personal data we collect and how we use it.

Sections.Heading: What we collect
Sections.Body: Account and contact details you give us, compliance records you add, and basic technical data such as your device and pages viewed (subject to your cookie choices).

Sections.Heading: How we use it
Sections.Body: To provide the service, keep it secure, respond to enquiries, and — only where you've agreed — to measure how the site is used. We don't sell your data.

Sections.Heading: Your rights
Sections.Body: You can ask to access, correct or delete your personal data, or object to certain uses. Contact us and we'll respond within the statutory timeframe.

Sections.Heading: Contact
Sections.Body: For any privacy question or request, contact us through the details on our contact page.

Title: Cookie Policy
MetaDescription: How Tedwren uses cookies and how you control them.

Sections.Heading: What cookies we use
Sections.Body: Essential cookies that make the site work, and — only with your consent — analytics cookies that help us understand usage.

Sections.Heading: Your choices
Sections.Body: No analytics or advertising cookies run before you consent. You can reject non-essential cookies in one click and change your mind at any time.

Sections.Heading: Managing cookies
Sections.Body: You can also control cookies through your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies may stop parts of the site working.

Title: Terms of Service
MetaDescription: The terms that govern your use of Tedwren.

Sections.Heading: Using Tedwren
Sections.Body: By using the service you agree to these terms. Use it lawfully and don't attempt to disrupt it or access data that isn't yours.

Sections.Heading: Your account
Sections.Body: Keep your login secure and the information in your account accurate. You're responsible for activity under your account.

Sections.Heading: Subscriptions and billing
Sections.Body: Paid plans are billed as described at sign-up. Worker Passport is billed annually with a 14-day right to cancel under UK distance-selling rules.

Sections.Heading: Availability
Sections.Body: We work to keep the service available but don't promise uninterrupted access, and we may update features over time.

Title: Data Protection
MetaDescription: How Tedwren meets its data-protection obligations.

Sections.Heading: Our commitment
Sections.Body: We handle personal data in line with UK data-protection law and only for the purposes set out in our privacy policy.

Sections.Heading: Data processing
Sections.Body: Where we process personal data on your behalf, we can provide a data-processing agreement setting out roles and responsibilities.

Sections.Heading: Security
Sections.Body: We apply appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data, described further on our Security & Trust page.

Sections.Heading: Contact
Sections.Body: For data-protection queries or to request a DPA, contact us through our contact page.
